questions.question: The sentence may contain 0, 1 or multiple errors. Click the incorrect parts and type the correct form. If no error, choose No Error.
questions.explanation: Standard third conditional uses past perfect (had + V3) in if-clause, not would have + V3. Correct: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.

description.en: Third conditional is used for imaginary past situations and hypothetical past results.
description.id: Third conditional untuk situasi imajiner di masa lalu.

wrong_correct.wrong: If I would have studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
wrong_correct.correct: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.

explanation.en: Use past perfect (had + V3) in if-clause, would have + V3 in main clause.
explanation.id: Gunakan past perfect di if-clause, bukan would have.

en.introduction: Third conditional describes something that did not happen and imagines a different result. Used for regret/criticism.

rules.title: 1. Basic Structure
rules.explanation: If-clause = imaginary past condition, Main clause = hypothetical past result.
rules.structure: If + subject + had + V3, subject + would have + V3.

common_mistakes.wrong: If I would have known, I would have helped.
common_mistakes.correct: If I had known, I would have helped.
common_mistakes.reason: Don't use would have in if-clause.

other_examples.sentence: If they had invited me, I would have attended.
other_examples.translation: Jika mereka mengundang saya, saya pasti hadir.

explanation.en: They didn't invite, so speaker didn't attend.

questions.question: Spot errors - third conditional with mixed modals.

correctAnswers: she would have passed the exam

questions.explanation: Imaginary past result needs would have + V3. Correct: would have passed, not would pass. Also, 'came' is incorrect; use past participle 'come'.
